n = int(input())
A = [0] * 20
B = [0] * 20
answer = float('inf')

for i in range(1, 17):
    B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1
A[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10

temp_n = n
digit_count = 0
while temp_n:
    digit_count += 1
    temp_n //= 10

def search(position, current_value, total_cost):
    global answer
    if total_cost >= answer:
        return
    if position == 0:
        if current_value == 0:
            answer = total_cost
        return
    quotient = current_value // A[position]
    neg_diff = abs(quotient) - 1
    if quotient < 0:
        neg_diff = -neg_diff
    pos_diff = abs(quotient) + 1
    if quotient < 0:
        pos_diff = -pos_diff

    search(position - 1, current_value - quotient * B[position], total_cost + abs(quotient) * position)
    search(position - 1, current_value - neg_diff * B[position], total_cost + abs(neg_diff) * position)
    search(position - 1, current_value - pos_diff * B[position], total_cost + abs(pos_diff) * position)

search(digit_count, n, 0)
search(digit_count, B[digit_count + 1] - n, digit_count + 1)
print(answer)
</translated_code>
